about: Reviewable retirement record for frozen M001-S01 test ids (01_data/baseline/test_ids_portable.json and the frozen live-R ids). A frozen id may stop being collected only when it is listed here with the retiring slice id, a reason, and optional replacement node ids; 06_infra/verification/pytest_guard.py requires each named replacement to be collected and pass, rejects entries for ids that are not frozen or are still collected, and rejects any other missing frozen id.
